title: 239 Pelican Circle | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Front With Private Pool, Private Beach, And Privat Beach Access- 239 Pelican Circle by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 239 Pelican Circle by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 239 Pelican Circle, Inlet Beach, FL 32461 Details: Welcome to 239 Pelican Circle in an exclusive gated community along Scenic 30A in Seacrest Beach. This stunning Gulf-front retreat features a spacious carriage house, a large private pool, and direct beach access, offering the ultimate coastal escape. Inside, coastal luxury meets relaxed comfort, with elegant design elements that create a warm, inviting atmosphere throughout the expansive living spaces. Breathtaking Gulf views fill nearly every room—where the emerald waters serve as both artwork and backdrop. The generous outdoor living areas are designed for connection and tranquility, surrounded by unrivaled panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico. Whether you’re gathering on the oversized screened deck, lounging by the palm-lined pool, or enjoying one of the many outdoor spaces, every corner of this home flows seamlessly together. Accommodating up to 15 guests comfortably, this property is perfect for large families, multi-family groups, or multi-generational getaways seeking a one-of-a-kind 30A experience. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front – Private Beach Access -Main House and Carriage House -Over 5,500 Sq Ft -Parking Spaces: (5) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: 15 -Gas Grill and Green Egg -*Private Pool: Large Lap Pool *Pool Heat is available for an additional $480 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 15 5 Bedrooms / 5 Baths First Floor (Main House): -Guest Bedroom 1: 2 Queen Beds and Private Bathroom. -Guest Bedroom 2: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds 1 Twin -Access to Pool Deck -Laundry Room Second Floor (Main House): -Guest Bedroom 3: King bed with Large Private Spa Bath -Guest Bedroom 4: King bed and Attached Shared Bath w Hallway Access -Living / Dining / Chefs Kitchen / Screened Porch w Panoramic Views / Private Beach Access Carriage House: -Guest Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath -Kitchen / Living / Access to Pool Deck Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service Please Note: -Fireplaces are not functional. -Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
